indicator_name: Velocity of money and monetisation (M2, M3), quarterly (computed by this repository)
description: Скорость обращения денег и монетизация экономики (M2, M3), поквартально (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: Velocity = nominal GDP of the last four quarters (QNA_GDP_EXPENDITURE item GDP) over the mean of the end-of-quarter stock and the stock a year earlier; monetisation = the end-of-quarter stock over the same GDP. The NBK stock dated the 1st of a month is the end of the previous one. From 2011.
